gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall, its x-height blocky like squared-off woodblock type and its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Anek Kannada is the solid footing under Funnel Display, whose spaghetti lines never change width.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-latin: Spaghetti lines, no hairlines anywhere: Funnel Display draws every letter in a single stroke width. And Anek Latin, its lowercase nearly touching capital height, can run a touch larger without closing up.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads clean and contemporary, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Anek Odia keeps its capitals barely above lowercase, a low-key foil for Funnel Display, whose strokes never vary in width.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads modern, its big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves giving lowercase plenty of room. Anek Tamil picks up where Funnel Display leaves off, trading that quiet, level beat for rounder lowercase.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anuphan: Spaghetti strokes, one thickness around every counter: Funnel Display is all outline and attitude. Anuphan lands softer, neutral and clean, with big round bowls and open curves that take the pressure off.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-athiti: Expressive Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like lines with c tips that never close in. Athiti, approachable and sign-shop simple with its see-through s, gives that showiness a friendly, single-line-width partner.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-biryani: Spaghetti-like strokes define Funnel Display, none thicker than another. Biryani meets that with large, clear eyes on every e and unclogged little counters, keeping the loud heading company without a fuss.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-comme: Flat and contrast-free, with spaghetti lines: that's Funnel Display. Funnel Display gets noticed, while Comme smooths the reading with unclogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-duru-sans: Pipe-cleaner letters, bent into a commanding display face. Duru Sans gives small letters generous openings and lets bodies dominate the line, leaving Funnel Display free to be the showoff.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-funnel-sans: Commanding Funnel Display draws spaghetti lines that never vary in width. Funnel Sans keeps stroke widths constant from stem to curve, so making the heading small or the body large would blur which one leads.
